#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

int main() {
    int n, budget;
    std::cin >> n >> budget;

    std::vector<int> numbers(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> numbers[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> differences;
    int balance = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (numbers[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++balance;
        } else {
            --balance;
        }

        if (i < n - 1 && balance == 0) {
            differences.push_back(std::abs(numbers[i] - numbers[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(differences.begin(), differences.end());

    int cuts = 0;
    for (int d : differences) {
        if (budget >= d) {
            budget -= d;
            ++cuts;
        }
    }

    std::cout << cuts << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
